title: Pure Cyclone
summary: The Cyclone series encompasses the iconic backrow removal Quick-Play Spells (Cosmic Cyclone, Galaxy Cyclone, Double Cyclone, and Mystical Space Typhoon) alongside Toy Box and Artifact synergy. By pairing Double Cyclone with cards that float when destroyed in the Spell & Trap Zone (like Artifact Moralltach, Wild Tornado, and Toy Box), you pop your own sets to obliterate the opponent's board.

allow.Toy Soldier: Sets itself as a Spell in the Spell & Trap Zone and Special Summons itself to search a Level 4 LIGHT monster when destroyed by Double Cyclone.
allow.Toy Tank: Sets itself as a Spell and revives a Level 6 or lower monster when destroyed by Double Cyclone.
allow.Artifact Moralltach: Sets itself in the Spell & Trap Zone and Special Summons itself to destroy an opponent's face-up card when destroyed by Double Cyclone on the opponent's turn.
allow.Night Beam: Destroys 1 Set Spell/Trap the opponent controls and prevents them from chaining the targeted card.
allow.Toy Box: Continuous Spell that sets Toy Soldier and Toy Tank from the Deck to be popped by Double Cyclone.
allow.Artifact Sanctum: Special Summons Artifact Moralltach from the Deck and destroys a card if popped by an opponent or Cyclone.
allow.Wild Tornado: Normal Trap that destroys 1 face-up card in the Spell & Trap Zone, and destroys ANY 1 face-up card on the field if destroyed while Set by Double Cyclone.
allow.Artifact Durendal: Rank 5 Xyz made with Level 5 Artifact Moralltach that forces the opponent's effect to become 'Destroy 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls'.
allow.Constellar Pleiades: Rank 5 LIGHT Xyz made with two Level 5 monsters that bounces a card on the field as a Quick Effect.

main: Toy Soldier
Sets itself in the Spell & Trap Zone as fodder for Double Cyclone and Special Summons itself to search Artifact Moralltach when sent to the GY.
Toy Tank
Sets itself in the Spell & Trap Zone and revives a monster when sent to the GY by Double Cyclone.
Artifact Moralltach
Set in the Spell & Trap Zone; when destroyed by Double Cyclone during the opponent's turn, it Special Summons itself and destroys 1 face-up card the opponent controls.
Cosmic Cyclone
Pays 1000 LP to banish 1 Spell/Trap on the field instead of destroying it.
Galaxy Cyclone
Destroys 1 Set Spell/Trap on the field, and banishes itself from the GY on a later turn to destroy 1 face-up Spell/Trap.
Double Cyclone
Core Quick-Play Spell that targets 1 Spell/Trap you control (Toy Soldier, Moralltach, or Wild Tornado) and 1 Spell/Trap the opponent controls and destroys both.
Mystical Space Typhoon
The original Cyclone Quick-Play Spell that destroys any 1 Spell/Trap on the field.
Night Beam
Destroys 1 Set Spell/Trap the opponent controls and prevents them from chaining the targeted card.
Toy Box
Places Toy Soldier and Toy Tank directly from the Deck into your Spell & Trap Zone as live targets for Double Cyclone.
Artifact Sanctum
Special Summons Artifact Moralltach directly from the Deck on the opponent's turn.
Wild Tornado
Destroys any face-up card on the field when destroyed while Set by Double Cyclone.
extra: Rank 5 Xyz made with Level 5 Artifact Moralltach that triggers Set Moralltachs and Wild Tornados.
Rank 5 LIGHT Xyz made with two Level 5 monsters that bounces a card on the field as a Quick Effect.
